evidence.claim: The diffusion decoder predicts logical errors conditioned on syndrome information through iterative denoising, analogous to conditional diffusion in image generation.

For the [[72,12,6]] and [[144,12,12]] BB-code tests under circuit-level noise, the masked diffusion decoder is among the lowest-LER methods and matches or exceeds BP-OSD in the tested regimes while offering better latency on the larger code.

Inference time scales approximately linearly with the number of diffusion steps T, and reducing T can preserve useful decoding accuracy; the paper identifies the source of residual accuracy differences as an open question.
